nm EQUITY RAISE (announced 2026-10-26, priced 2026-10-26/27; issuer documents nm_fwp_launch_20261026, nm_fwp_pricing_20261027, nm_8k_20261029; the share data of the 10-Q cover nm facts are on the pre-raise basis) Financing plan stated by the issuer: about 35 billion USD of concurrent underwritten offerings (about 22.5 billion Class A, later upsized to 25.0 billion, plus about 12.5 billion of preferred) and a FUTURE at-the-market program of about 60 billion USD planned to launch when the new Class C stock starts trading (no agreement entered, timing, size and terms undetermined, no assurance). (1) CLASS A FORWARD SALE: 40,000,000 Class A shares sold at 625.00 USD (46,000,000 if the underwriters' 30-day option for 6,000,000 more is exercised, then with extra forward agreements) by forward sellers borrowing shares; Meta receives NO cash at pricing and issues shares to Morgan Stanley Capital Services and Goldman Sachs only on settlement, at Meta's election on one or more dates on or before 2027-11-19, at the forward price: initial 622.91875 USD (public price less discount), adjusted daily by a floating interest factor (overnight bank funding rate less a spread) and reduced on specified dates by the expected dividends; expected net proceeds about 24.9 billion (about 28.7 billion with the option) before expenses. After the Class C effective date (2027-01-19) each agreement references Class A and Class C and Meta may settle in Class C only, with a forward-price adjustment tied to the Class A / Class C price difference; the purchasers may accelerate (borrow failure, special dividend, ownership thresholds, extraordinary events). Until settlement the shares count in diluted EPS only by the treasury-stock method (not read from the filing; analyst to confirm), so basic shares stay 2,556 million, diluted weighted 2,573 million (Q3). (2) SERIES A MANDATORY CONVERTIBLE PREFERRED: 250,000,000 depositary shares at 50.00 USD (each 1/20 of a preferred share, 12,500,000 preferred shares, liquidation preference 1,000 USD each = 12.5 billion USD gross), over-allotment option 37,500,000 depositary shares (1,875,000 preferred shares, 1.875 billion) for 30 days; the offering closed 2026-10-29 (8-K), so about 12.5 billion of gross cash arrived on 2026-10-29 (underwriting discount not read: the final prospectus supplement was not saved; whether the option was exercised is not known). Dividend 6.50% of the liquidation preference a year = 812.5 million USD a year on 12.5 billion (derived: 203.1 million a quarter, 0.8125 USD per depositary share), cumulative, paid when declared in cash or Class A (later Class C) shares or a mix at the board's choice, quarterly on 2/15, 5/15, 8/15, 11/15 from 2027-02-15 (first payment 19.1389 USD per preferred share = about 239 million) to 2029-08-15 (11 payments, about 2.27 billion in total, derived). Mandatory conversion about 2029-08-15 into Class A (Class C once the trigger event has occurred): 1.6000 shares per preferred share if the price is below the initial price 625.00 USD, 1,000 USD divided by the price between 625.00 and the threshold appreciation price 734.2144 (17.5% above), 1.3620 shares above it; floor price 218.75 USD. As-converted shares 17.0 to 20.0 million (12.5 million preferred shares x 1.3620 to 1.6000, derived), 19.6 to 23.0 million with the option. At 614.00 the preferred converts at the maximum rate into shares worth 982.4 USD per 1,000 USD of preference (derived, price today, not a forecast); early conversion on a fundamental change at table rates (1.3520-1.6000). (3) DILUTION ARITHMETIC (derived from the filed terms, pre-split basis, against 2,556.2 million Class A+B shares on 2026-10-16): forward 40.0 million = +1.6% (46.0 million = +1.8%), preferred 17.0-20.0 million = +0.7-0.8% (19.6-23.0 million with the option), together 57.0-60.0 million = +2.2-2.3% (65.6-69.0 million = +2.6-2.7% with both options); a 60 billion ATM at 614.00 would be about 97.7 million shares (+3.8%, hypothetical because no agreement exists) and everything planned (about 95 billion at 614.00) about 155 million shares (+6.1%, illustrative only). The forward and the preferred are sold at about the same price as the market (625.00 vs 630.56 prior close and 614.00 now), i.e. no discount to the market is embedded beyond the 0.33% forward discount; the cost is the 6.5% preferred coupon (after-tax cost below the common's earnings yield on 614.00 / 29.33 only if the stock is above the conversion price) and the new claim ranking ahead of common. (4) FUNDING CONTEXT: capex guide 2026 135-145 billion incl. finance leases, 9M spent 85.8 billion, Q4 implies 49-59 billion; cash and marketable securities 82.45 billion at 2026-09-30 (issuer statement 'approximately 82 billion', nm_fwp_launch_20261026) plus about 12.5 billion preferred gross on 2026-10-29 gives about 95 billion pro forma (derived); the forward proceeds (about 24.9 billion) arrive only at settlement, by 2027-11-19. Issuer: 'balanced mix of operating cash flow, investment-grade debt, strategic partnerships and equity', Aa3/AA- ratings (issuer statement, not verified). For the analyst: model the 40 million forward shares and the preferred conversion shares as future common issuance, the preferred dividend as a claim ahead of common EPS (about 0.32 USD per share a year on 2,573 million diluted shares, derived), and the ATM as a visible unagreed funding option, never as a base-case fact.
